attempt_policy.infrastructure_retry: Only after a documented infrastructure failure that produced no valid image; repeat identical frozen inputs and preserve the failed attempt.
attempt_policy.inspection_order: Submit all four Set A jobs before any visual inspection; submit all four Set B jobs without inspecting intermediate results.

interpretation_boundary.seed_scope: The seed supports ZIT reproducibility only and is not claimed to correspond to another renderer's latent seed.
interpretation_boundary.evidence_scope: Concept renders only; not CAD, thermal, manufacturability, acoustic, EMC, electrical, or physical-validation evidence.
